versos.grego: Συνκαλεσάμενος δὲ τοὺς δώδεκα ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς δύναμιν καὶ ἐξουσίαν ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ δαιμόνια καὶ νόσους θεραπεύειν·

controles.web: He called the twelve together, and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.
controles.kjv: Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases.
controles.livre: Jesus convocou seus doze discípulos, e lhes deu poder e autoridade sobre todos os demônios, e para curarem enfermidades.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς κηρύσσειν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἰᾶσθαι,

controles.web: He sent them out to preach the Kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.
controles.kjv: And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.
controles.livre: E os enviou para pregar o reino de Deus e para curar os enfermos.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Μηδὲν αἴρετε εἰς τὴν ὁδόν, μήτε ῥάβδον μήτε πήραν μήτε ἄρτον μήτε ἀργύριον μήτε ἀνὰ δύο χιτῶνας ἔχειν.

controles.web: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—neither staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money; neither have two coats apiece.
controles.kjv: And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor scrip, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece.
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: “Não tomeis nada convosco para o caminho: nem vara, nem bolsa, nem pão, nem dinheiro, nem tenhais duas túnicas cada um.

versos.grego: καὶ εἰς ἣν ἂν οἰκίαν εἰσέλθητε, ἐκεῖ μένετε καὶ ἐκεῖθεν ἐξέρχεσθε.

controles.web: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.
controles.kjv: And whatsoever house ye enter into, there abide, and thence depart.
controles.livre: E em qualquer casa que entrardes, ficai ali, e dali saí.

versos.grego: καὶ ὅσοι ἂν μὴ δέχωνται ὑμᾶς, ἐξερχόμενοι ἀπὸ τῆς πόλεως ἐκείνης τὸν κονιορτὸν ἀπὸ τῶν ποδῶν ὑμῶν ἀποτινάσσετε εἰς μαρτύριον ἐπ’ αὐτούς.

controles.web: As many as don’t receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”
controles.kjv: And whosoever will not receive you, when ye go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them.
controles.livre: E a todo os que não vos receberem, quando sairdes daquela cidade, sacudi até o pó dos vossos pés, em testemunho contra eles”.

versos.grego: ἐξερχόμενοι δὲ διήρχοντο κατὰ τὰς κώμας εὐαγγελιζόμενοι καὶ θεραπεύοντες πανταχοῦ.

controles.web: They departed, and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News, and healing everywhere.
controles.kjv: And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where.
controles.livre: Então eles partiram, e percorreram todas as aldeias, anunciando o Evangelho, e curando em todos os lugares.

versos.grego: Ἤκουσεν δὲ Ἡρῴδης ὁ τετραάρχης τὰ γινόμενα πάντα, καὶ διηπόρει διὰ τὸ λέγεσθαι ὑπό τινων ὅτι Ἰωάνης ἠγέρθη ἐκ νεκρῶν,

controles.web: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,
controles.kjv: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead;
controles.livre: E o tetrarca Herodes ouvia falar todas as coisas que ele fazia; e estava perplexo, porque alguns diziam que João tinha ressuscitado dos mortos;

versos.grego: ὑπό τινων δὲ ὅτι Ἡλείας ἐφάνη, ἄλλων δὲ ὅτι προφήτης τις τῶν ἀρχαίων ἀνέστη.

controles.web: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.
controles.kjv: And of some, that Elias had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again.
controles.livre: e outros, que Elias havia aparecido; e outros, que algum profeta dos antigos havia ressuscitado.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ Ἡρῴδης Ἰωάνην ἐγὼ ἀπεκεφάλισα· τίς δέ ἐστιν οὗτος περὶ οὗ ἀκούω τοιαῦτα; καὶ ἐζήτει ἰδεῖν αὐτόν.

controles.web: Herod said, “John I beheaded, but who is this, about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.
controles.kjv: And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him.
controles.livre: E Herodes disse: “A João mandei degolar; quem, pois, é este, de quem tais coisas ouço?” E procurava vê-lo.

versos.grego: Καὶ ὑποστρέψαντες οἱ ἀπόστολοι διηγήσαντο αὐτῷ ὅσα ἐποίησαν. Καὶ παραλαβὼν αὐτοὺς ὑπεχώρησεν κατ’ ἰδίαν εἰς πόλιν καλουμένην Βηθσαϊδά.

controles.web: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done.   He took them, and withdrew apart to a deserted place of a city called Bethsaida.
controles.kjv: And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida.
controles.livre: E quando os apóstolos, voltaram, contaram a Jesus todas as coisas que tinham feito. Então ele os tomou consigo, e retirou-se à parte a um lugar deserto de uma cidade chamada Betsaida.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ὄχλοι γνόντες ἠκολούθησαν αὐτῷ· καὶ ἀποδεξάμενος αὐτοὺς ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς περὶ τῆς βασιλείας τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ τοὺς χρείαν ἔχοντας θεραπείας ἰᾶτο.

controles.web: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, and spoke to them of the Kingdom of God, and he cured those who needed healing.
controles.kjv: And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spake unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing.
controles.livre: E quando as multidões souberam, seguiram-no. Ele as recebeu, e lhes falava do Reino de Deus, e curava aos que precisavam de cura.

versos.grego: Ἡ δὲ ἡμέρα ἤρξατο κλίνειν· προσελθόντες δὲ οἱ δώδεκα εἶπαν αὐτῷ Ἀπόλυσον τὸν ὄχλον, ἵνα πορευθέντες εἰς τὰς κύκλῳ κώμας καὶ ἀγροὺς καταλύσωσιν καὶ εὕρωσιν ἐπισιτισμόν, ὅτι ὧδε ἐν ἐρήμῳ τόπῳ ἐσμέν.

controles.web: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came, and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms, and lodge, and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”
controles.kjv: And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place.
controles.livre: E o dia já começava a declinar. Então os doze se aproximaram dele, e lhe disseram: “Despede a multidão, para irem aos lugares e aldeias ao redor, se agasalhem, e achem o que comer; porque aqui estamos em lugar deserto”.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς Δότε αὐτοῖς φαγεῖν ὑμεῖς. οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Οὐκ εἰσὶν ἡμῖν πλεῖον ἢ ἄρτοι πέντε καὶ ἰχθύες δύο, εἰ μήτι πορευθέντες ἡμεῖς ἀγοράσωμεν εἰς πάντα τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον βρώματα.

controles.web: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.”   They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”
controles.kjv: But he said unto them, Give ye them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy meat for all this people.
controles.livre: Mas ele lhes disse: “Dai-lhes vós de comer”. E eles disseram: “Não temos mais que cinco pães e dois peixes; a não ser se formos nós mesmos comprar de comer para todo este povo”.

versos.grego: ἦσαν γὰρ ὡσεὶ ἄνδρες πεντακισχίλιοι. εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ Κατακλίνατε αὐτοὺς κλισίας ὡσεὶ ἀνὰ πεντήκοντα.

controles.web: For they were about five thousand men.   He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”
controles.kjv: For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company.
controles.livre: Porque havia ali quase cinco mil homens. Então disse aos seus discípulos: “Fazei-os se sentarem em grupos de cinquenta em cinquenta”.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐποίησαν οὕτως καὶ κατέκλιναν ἅπαντας.

controles.web: They did so, and made them all sit down.
controles.kjv: And they did so, and made them all sit down.
controles.livre: E assim procederam, fazendo todos se sentarem.

versos.grego: λαβὼν δὲ τοὺς πέντε ἄρτους καὶ τοὺς δύο ἰχθύας, ἀναβλέψας εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν εὐλόγησεν αὐτοὺς καὶ κατέκλασεν, καὶ ἐδίδου τοῖς μαθηταῖς παραθεῖναι τῷ ὄχλῳ.

controles.web: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, and broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.
controles.kjv: Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude.
controles.livre: Então ele tomou os cinco pães e os dois peixes e, olhando para o céu, abençoou-os e partiu-os, e os deu a seus discípulos, para os porem diante da multidão.

versos.grego: καὶ ἔφαγον καὶ ἐχορτάσθησαν πάντες, καὶ ἤρθη τὸ περισσεῦσαν αὐτοῖς κλασμάτων κόφινοι δώδεκα.

controles.web: They ate, and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.
controles.kjv: And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets.
controles.livre: E todos comeram, e saciaram-se; e levantaram doze cestos de pedaços que sobraram.

versos.grego: Καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτὸν προσευχόμενον κατὰ μόνας συνῆσαν αὐτῷ οἱ μαθηταί, καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτοὺς λέγων Τίνα με οἱ ὄχλοι λέγουσιν εἶναι;

controles.web: As he was praying alone, the disciples were with him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am?
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, quando ele estava orando só, e seus discípulos estavam com ele, que ele lhes perguntou: “Quem as multidões dizem que eu sou?”

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἀποκριθέντες εἶπαν Ἰωάνην τὸν Βαπτιστήν, ἄλλοι δὲ Ἡλείαν, ἄλλοι δὲ ὅτι προφήτης τις τῶν ἀρχαίων ἀνέστη.

controles.web: They answered, “‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets is risen again.”
controles.kjv: They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elias; and others say, that one of the old prophets is risen again.
controles.livre: E eles responderam: “Uns , João Batista; outros, Elias; e outros, que algum dos profetas antigos ressuscitou”.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς Ὑμεῖς δὲ τίνα με λέγετε εἶναι; Πέτρος δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν Τὸν Χριστὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”   Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”
controles.kjv: He said unto them, But whom say ye that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God.
controles.livre: E disse-lhes: “E vós, quem dizeis que eu sou?” E Pedro respondeu: “O Cristo de Deus”.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ ἐπιτιμήσας αὐτοῖς παρήγγειλεν μηδενὶ λέγειν τοῦτο,

controles.web: But he warned them, and commanded them to tell this to no one,
controles.kjv: And he straitly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing;
controles.livre: Então ele os alertou, e mandou-lhes que não dissessem a ninguém,

versos.grego: εἰπὼν ὅτι Δεῖ τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου πολλὰ παθεῖν καὶ ἀποδοκιμασθῆναι ἀπὸ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων καὶ ἀρχιερέων καὶ γραμματέων καὶ ἀποκτανθῆναι καὶ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ἐγερθῆναι.

controles.web: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”
controles.kjv: Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day.
controles.livre: dizendo: “É necessário que o Filho do homem sofra muitas coisas; que seja rejeitado pelos anciãos, pelos chefes dos sacerdotes, e pelos escribas; que seja morto, e que seja ressuscitado ao terceiro dia”.

versos.grego: Ἔλεγεν δὲ πρὸς πάντας Εἴ τις θέλει ὀπίσω μου ἔρχεσθαι, ἀρνησάσθω ἑαυτὸν καὶ ἀράτω τὸν σταυρὸν αὐτοῦ καθ’ ἡμέραν, καὶ ἀκολουθείτω μοι.

controles.web: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross,and follow me.
controles.kjv: And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me.
controles.livre: E dizia a todos: “Se alguém quer vir após mim, negue-se a si mesmo, tome cada dia sua cruz, e siga- me.

versos.grego: ὃς γὰρ ἐὰν θέλῃ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ σῶσαι, ἀπολέσει αὐτήν· ὃς δ’ ἂν ἀπολέσῃ τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἕνεκεν ἐμοῦ, οὗτος σώσει αὐτήν.

controles.web: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake, the same will save it.
controles.kjv: For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it.
controles.livre: Pois quem quiser salvar sua vida a perderá; porém quem, por minha causa, perder a sua vida, esse a salvará.

versos.grego: τί γὰρ ὠφελεῖται ἄνθρωπος κερδήσας τὸν κόσμον ὅλον ἑαυτὸν δὲ ἀπολέσας ἢ ζημιωθείς;

controles.web: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?
controles.kjv: For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away?
controles.livre: Porque, que aproveita para alguém ganhar o mundo todo, e perder ou prejudicar a si mesmo?

versos.grego: ὃς γὰρ ἂν ἐπαισχυνθῇ με καὶ τοὺς ἐμοὺς λόγους, τοῦτον ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐπαισχυνθήσεται, ὅταν ἔλθῃ ἐν τῇ δόξῃ αὐτοῦ καὶ τοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ τῶν ἁγίων ἀγγέλων.

controles.web: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed, when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.
controles.kjv: For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father’s, and of the holy angels.
controles.livre: Pois quem se envergonhar de mim e das minhas palavras, dele o Filho do homem se envergonhará, quando vier na sua glória, e na do Pai, e dos santos anjos.

versos.grego: λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν ἀληθῶς, εἰσίν τινες τῶν αὐτοῦ ἑστηκότων οἳ οὐ μὴ γεύσωνται θανάτου ἕως ἂν ἴδωσιν τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here, who will in no way taste of death, until they see the Kingdom of God.”
controles.kjv: But I tell you of a truth, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God.
controles.livre: E em verdade vos digo que, dentre os que aqui estão, há alguns que não experimentarão a morte, até que vejam o Reino de Deus”.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δὲ μετὰ τοὺς λόγους τούτους ὡσεὶ ἡμέραι ὀκτὼ, καὶ παραλαβὼν Πέτρον καὶ Ἰωάνην καὶ Ἰάκωβον ἀνέβη εἰς τὸ ὄρος προσεύξασθαι.

controles.web: About eight days after these sayings, he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, quase oito dias depois dessas palavras, ele tomou consigo a Pedro, João, e a Jacó, e subiu ao monte para orar.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ προσεύχεσθαι αὐτὸν τὸ εἶδος τοῦ προσώπου αὐτοῦ ἕτερον καὶ ὁ ἱματισμὸς αὐτοῦ λευκὸς ἐξαστράπτων.

controles.web: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.
controles.kjv: And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and glistering.
controles.livre: E ele, enquanto estava orando, a aparência do seu rosto se transfigurou, e sua roupa ficou branca e brilhante.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνδρες δύο συνελάλουν αὐτῷ, οἵτινες ἦσαν Μωϋσῆς καὶ Ἡλείας,

controles.web: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,
controles.kjv: And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elias:
controles.livre: E eis que estavam falando com ele dois homens, que eram Moisés e Elias,

versos.grego: οἳ ὀφθέντες ἐν δόξῃ ἔλεγον τὴν ἔξοδον αὐτοῦ, ἣν ἤμελλεν πληροῦν ἐν Ἱερουσαλήμ.

controles.web: who appeared in glory, and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: Who appeared in glory, and spake of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem.
controles.livre: os quais apareceram com glória, e falavam de sua partida, que estava para se cumprir em Jerusalém.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Πέτρος καὶ οἱ σὺν αὐτῷ ἦσαν βεβαρημένοι ὕπνῳ· διαγρηγορήσαντες δὲ εἶδαν τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς δύο ἄνδρας τοὺς συνεστῶτας αὐτῷ.

controles.web: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.
controles.kjv: But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him.
controles.livre: Pedro e os que estavam com ele estavam cheios de sono; e quando despertaram, viram a glória dele, e aqueles dois homens que estavam com ele.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ διαχωρίζεσθαι αὐτοὺς ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ εἶπεν ὁ Πέτρος πρὸς τὸν Ἰησοῦν Ἐπιστάτα, καλόν ἐστιν ἡμᾶς ὧδε εἶναι, καὶ ποιήσωμεν σκηνὰς τρεῖς, μίαν σοὶ καὶ μίαν Μωϋσεῖ καὶ μίαν Ἡλείᾳ, μὴ εἰδὼς ὃ λέγει.

controles.web: As they were parting from him, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” not knowing what he said.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for thee, and one for Moses, and one for Elias: not knowing what he said.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, quando eles estavam saíndo da presença dele, Pedro disse a Jesus: “Mestre, é bom estarmos nós aqui. Façamos três tendas, uma para ti, uma para Moisés, e uma para Elias”, não sabendo o que dizia.

versos.grego: ταῦτα δὲ αὐτοῦ λέγοντος ἐγένετο νεφέλη καὶ ἐπεσκίαζεν αὐτούς· ἐφοβήθησαν δὲ ἐν τῷ εἰσελθεῖν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν νεφέλην.

controles.web: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.
controles.kjv: While he thus spake, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud.
controles.livre: E enquanto ele dizia isso, veio uma nuvem que os cobriu com a sua sombra; e, quando entraram na nuvem, temeram.

versos.grego: καὶ φωνὴ ἐγένετο ἐκ τῆς νεφέλης λέγουσα Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Υἱός μου ὁ ἐκλελεγμένος, αὐτοῦ ἀκούετε.

controles.web: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”
controles.kjv: And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him.
controles.livre: E veio uma voz da nuvem, que dizia: “Este é o meu Filho amado; a ele ouvi”.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐν τῷ γενέσθαι τὴν φωνὴν εὑρέθη Ἰησοῦς μόνος. καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐσίγησαν καὶ οὐδενὶ ἀπήγγειλαν ἐν ἐκείναις ταῖς ἡμέραις οὐδὲν ὧν ἑώρακαν.

controles.web: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.
controles.kjv: And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen.
controles.livre: E, depois de terminada aquela voz, Jesus se encontrava só; e eles se calaram, e por aqueles dias não contaram a ninguém nada do que tinham visto.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δὲ τῇ ἑξῆς ἡμέρᾳ κατελθόντων αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους συνήντησεν αὐτῷ ὄχλος πολύς.

controles.web: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him.
controles.livre: E aconteceu no dia seguinte que, descendo eles do monte, uma grande multidão lhe saiu ao encontro.

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνὴρ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄχλου ἐβόησεν λέγων Διδάσκαλε, δέομαί σου ἐπιβλέψαι ἐπὶ τὸν υἱόν μου, ὅτι μονογενής μοί ἐστιν,

controles.web: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only child.
controles.kjv: And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I beseech thee, look upon my son: for he is mine only child.
controles.livre: E eis que um homem da multidão clamou: “Mestre, rogo-te que vejas a meu filho, que é o único que tenho,

versos.grego: καὶ ἰδοὺ πνεῦμα λαμβάνει αὐτόν, καὶ ἐξαίφνης κράζει καὶ σπαράσσει αὐτὸν μετὰ ἀφροῦ, καὶ μόλις ἀποχωρεῖ ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ συντρῖβον αὐτόν·

controles.web: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams, and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.
controles.kjv: And, lo, a spirit taketh him, and he suddenly crieth out; and it teareth him that he foameth again, and bruising him hardly departeth from him.
controles.livre: e eis que um espírito o toma, e de repente grita, e o convulsiona até espumar, e somente sai dele quando o maltrata severamente.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐδεήθην τῶν μαθητῶν σου ἵνα ἐκβάλωσιν αὐτό, καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνήθησαν.

controles.web: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”
controles.kjv: And I besought thy disciples to cast him out; and they could not.
controles.livre: E roguei aos teus discípulos que o exupulsassem, mas não conseguiram”.

versos.grego: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Ὦ γενεὰ ἄπιστος καὶ διεστραμμένη, ἕως πότε ἔσομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ ἀνέξομαι ὑμῶν; προσάγαγε ὧδε τὸν υἱόν σου.

controles.web: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”
controles.kjv: And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring thy son hither.
controles.livre: E Jesus respondeu: “Ó geração incrédula e perversa! Até quando estarei ainda convosco, e vos suportarei? Traze aqui teu filho”.

versos.grego: ἔτι δὲ προσερχομένου αὐτοῦ ἔρρηξεν αὐτὸν τὸ δαιμόνιον καὶ συνεσπάραξεν· ἐπετίμησεν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς τῷ πνεύματι τῷ ἀκαθάρτῳ, καὶ ἰάσατο τὸν παῖδα καὶ ἀπέδωκεν αὐτὸν τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ.

controles.web: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.
controles.kjv: And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father.
controles.livre: E quando ainda vinha chegando, o demônio o derrubou, e o convulsionou. Porém Jesus repreendeu o espírito imundo, curou ao menino, e o devolveu ao seu pai.

versos.grego: ἐξεπλήσσοντο δὲ πάντες ἐπὶ τῇ μεγαλειότητι τοῦ Θεοῦ. Πάντων δὲ θαυμαζόντων ἐπὶ πᾶσιν οἷς ἐποίει εἶπεν πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ

controles.web: They were all astonished at the majesty of God.   But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,
controles.kjv: And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples,
controles.livre: E todos ficaram perplexos com a grandeza de Deus. E enquanto todos se maravilhavam de tudo o que Jesus fazia, disse aos seus discípulos:

versos.grego: Θέσθε ὑμεῖς εἰς τὰ ὦτα ὑμῶν τοὺς λόγους τούτους· ὁ γὰρ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου μέλλει παραδίδοσθαι εἰς χεῖρας ἀνθρώπων.

controles.web: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”
controles.kjv: Let these sayings sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men.
controles.livre: “Ponde vós em vossos ouvidos estas palavras: que o Filho do homem será entregue nas mãos dos homens”.

versos.grego: οἱ δὲ ἠγνόουν τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο, καὶ ἦν παρακεκαλυμμένον ἀπ’ αὐτῶν ἵνα μὴ αἴσθωνται αὐτό, καὶ ἐφοβοῦντο ἐρωτῆσαι αὐτὸν περὶ τοῦ ῥήματος τούτου.

controles.web: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.
controles.kjv: But they understood not this saying, and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying.
controles.livre: Mas eles não entendiam essa palavra, e era-lhes encoberta, para que não a compreendessem; e temiam perguntar-lhe sobre essa palavra.

versos.grego: Εἰσῆλθεν δὲ διαλογισμὸς ἐν αὐτοῖς, τὸ τίς ἂν εἴη μείζων αὐτῶν.

controles.web: There arose an argument among them about which of them was the greatest.
controles.kjv: Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest.
controles.livre: E levantou-se entre eles uma discussão sobre qual deles seria o maior.

versos.grego: ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς εἰδὼς τὸν διαλογισμὸν τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν, ἐπιλαβόμενος παιδίον ἔστησεν αὐτὸ παρ’ ἑαυτῷ,

controles.web: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,
controles.kjv: And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him,
controles.livre: Mas Jesus, conhecendo o pensamento de seus corações, pegou uma criança, e a pôs junto a si.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ὃς ἐὰν δέξηται τοῦτο τὸ παιδίον ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί μου, ἐμὲ δέχεται· καὶ ὃς ἂν ἐμὲ δέξηται, δέχεται τὸν ἀποστείλαντά με· ὁ γὰρ μικρότερος ἐν πᾶσιν ὑμῖν ὑπάρχων οὗτός ἐστιν μέγας.

controles.web: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”
controles.kjv: And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receiveth me: and whosoever shall receive me receiveth him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great.
controles.livre: Então disse-lhes: “Quem receber esta criança em meu nome, a mim me recebe; e quem receber a mim, recebe o que me enviou; porque aquele que entre todos vós for o menor, esse será grande”.

versos.grego: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰωάνης εἶπεν Ἐπιστάτα, εἴδομέν τινα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἐκβάλλοντα δαιμόνια, καὶ ἐκωλύομεν αὐτὸν, ὅτι οὐκ ἀκολουθεῖ μεθ’ ἡμῶν.

controles.web: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”
controles.kjv: And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in thy name; and we forbad him, because he followeth not with us.
controles.livre: João respondeu: “Mestre, vimos um que em teu nome expulsava os demônios, e nós o proibimos, porque não segue conosco”.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν Ἰησοῦς Μὴ κωλύετε· ὃς γὰρ οὐκ ἔστιν καθ’ ὑμῶν, ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐστιν.

controles.web: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”
controles.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhe disse: “Não o proibais, porque quem não é contra nós, é por nós”.

versos.grego: Ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ συμπληροῦσθαι τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ἀναλήμψεως αὐτοῦ καὶ αὐτὸς τὸ πρόσωπον ἐστήρισεν τοῦ πορεύεσθαι εἰς Ἱερουσαλήμ,

controles.web: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem,
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he stedfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem,
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, quando completaram-se os dias em que ele viria a ser recebido no alto, ele se determinou a ir para Jerusalém.

versos.grego: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ἀγγέλους πρὸ προσώπου αὐτοῦ. καὶ πορευθέντες εἰσῆλθον εἰς κώμην Σαμαρειτῶν, ὥστε ἑτοιμάσαι αὐτῷ·

controles.web: and sent messengers before his face. They went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.
controles.kjv: And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him.
controles.livre: E mandou mensageiros adiante de si;  e eles se foram, e entraram numa aldeia de samaritanos, para lhe fazerem os preparativos.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐκ ἐδέξαντο αὐτόν, ὅτι τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἦν πορευόμενον εἰς Ἱερουσαλήμ.

controles.web: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set towards Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem.
controles.livre: Mas não o receberam, porque seu rosto demonstrava que ele ia para Jerusalém.

versos.grego: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ μαθηταὶ Ἰάκωβος καὶ Ἰωάνης εἶπαν Κύριε, θέλεις εἴπωμεν πῦρ καταβῆναι ἀπὸ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἀναλῶσαι αὐτούς;

controles.web: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky, and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”
controles.kjv: And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, wilt thou that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elias did?
controles.livre: Quando seus discípulos, Tiago e João, viram isso , disseram: “Senhor, queres que digamos que desça fogo do céu e os consuma, como Elias também fez?”

versos.grego: στραφεὶς δὲ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτοῖς.

controles.web: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.
controles.kjv: But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, Ye know not what manner of spirit ye are of.
controles.livre: Porém ele se virou, repreendeu-os.

versos.grego: καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν εἰς ἑτέραν κώμην.

controles.web: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.”   They went to another village.
controles.kjv: For the Son of man is not come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them. And they went to another village.
controles.livre: E  foram para outra aldeia.

versos.grego: Καὶ πορευομένων αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ εἶπέν τις πρὸς αὐτόν Ἀκολουθήσω σοι ὅπου ἐὰν ἀπέρχῃ.

controles.web: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow thee whithersoever thou goest.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, enquanto eles iam pelo caminho, alguém lhe disse: “Senhor, eu te seguirei para onde quer que fores”.

versos.grego: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ Ἰησοῦς Αἱ ἀλώπεκες φωλεοὺς ἔχουσιν καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατασκηνώσεις, ὁ δὲ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου οὐκ ἔχει ποῦ τὴν κεφαλὴν κλίνῃ.

controles.web: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”
controles.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man hath not where to lay his head.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhe disse: “As raposas têm tocas, e as aves do céu, ninhos; mas o Filho do homem não tem onde deitar a cabeça”.

versos.grego: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς ἕτερον Ἀκολούθει μοι. ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Ἐπίτρεψόν μοι πρῶτον ἀπελθόντι θάψαι τὸν πατέρα μου.

controles.web: He said to another, “Follow me!”   But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”
controles.kjv: And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father.
controles.livre: E disse a outro: “Segue-me”. Porém ele disse: “Senhor, deixa-me que primeiro eu vá, e eu enterre meu pai”.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ Ἄφες τοὺς νεκροὺς θάψαι τοὺς ἑαυτῶν νεκρούς, σὺ δὲ ἀπελθὼν διάγγελλε τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce the Kingdom of God.”
controles.kjv: Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go thou and preach the kingdom of God.
controles.livre: Mas Jesus lhe disse: “Deixa os mortos enterrarem os seus próprios mortos; tu, porém, vai, e anuncia o reino de Deus”.

versos.grego: Εἶπεν δὲ καὶ ἕτερος Ἀκολουθήσω σοι, Κύριε· πρῶτον δὲ ἐπίτρεψόν μοι ἀποτάξασθαι τοῖς εἰς τὸν οἶκόν μου.

controles.web: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”
controles.kjv: And another also said, Lord, I will follow thee; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house.
controles.livre: E outro também disse: “Senhor, eu te seguirei; mas deixa-me primeiro despedir dos que estão em minha casa”.

versos.grego: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Οὐδεὶς ἐπιβαλὼν τὴν χεῖρα ἐπ’ ἄροτρον καὶ βλέπων εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω εὔθετός ἐστιν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for the Kingdom of God.”
controles.kjv: And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.
controles.livre: E Jesus lhe disse: “Ninguém que colocar a sua mão no arado e olhar para trás é apto para o reino de Deus”.
